description:
Experience the evolution of all-terrain with Raso Gravel, a high-performance trail bike built to bring the speed of the road to the fastest gravel races in the world.

Informed by the pace and feel of a pure road bike, Raso Gravel rides with startling speed, pinpoint cockpit control and the instantaneous acceleration of a thoroughbred. Crest climbs quicker and descend with sure-footed confidence and reassuring grip - Raso Gravel brings the best of the hardtop to the trail to transform your off-road experience.

Think of Raso Gravel as a road bike for riding the toughest trails with big tires. Really big tires. You can spec Raso Gravel to accept up to 48mm on a 700c wheel with either 2x and 1x compatibility. For those looking to go bigger, the new Raso Gravel WIDE offers up to 55mm (2.2”) of clearance. Learn more on the Raso Gravel WIDE page.

Raso Gravel inherits the real-world aero performance of its sister frame, Raso. With its integrated front end, clean lines and tube shapes designed, optimized and positioned to cut through the air, Raso Gravel’s slim-line silhouette cuts a fast dash for the finish, empowering you to ride your best race.

With UDH compatibility at its core, we’re proud to present Raso Gravel with industry-accepted, future-proof technologies that greatly enhance your riding experience and confidence over rockier passes.

Wider tires and the demands of off-road riding led us to design a new front fork for Raso Gravel. Vibration-dampening, torsionally stiff and visually stunning, the new fork inherits the well-balanced lines of our road silhouette, with the added resilience and compliance trail conditions demand.

Like every Sarto, Raso Gravel is a product of in-house design and manufacture. From the first fiber, we work under one roof, forming, shaping, bonding and painting everything here at our HQ in Venice, Italy. Stock is not in our vocabulary. We create at the cutting edge of custom, crafting frame compositions, geometries and specifications for every rider in the ultimate realization of bespoke, handmade precision.

Raso Gravel arrives at the trailhead backed by decades of composites R&D, the exceptional quality of traceable, locally sourced carbon fiber, and the confidence of our in-house testing procedures. The freedom afforded by working under one roof enables us to create with unmatched agility and fidelity, driven by an iterative mindset that strives to exceed exceptional at every turn.

frame.material_detail: M46J/CN80/T800 carbon, UD carbon fibre or Tri-Composite outer layer
